mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park, a Waxing Crescent moon, and an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are an early bird, look up at 4:47 AM to catch the International Space Station crossing from the south over Belleville toward the east near Fitchburg.

The city has a few updates to share. The Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various roles, and road work begins August 18 on Highway M which will include lane shifts and a temporary closure of the driveway leading to Alliant and Kwik Trip.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee, plus a girls try hockey event. Tomorrow, head to Epic for the User Group Meeting or visit Insight Wellness for yoga.
Reviewing the police department report, on August 6, an officer stopped a driver for erratic behavior, resulting in an arrest for a fourth O W I offence.
The flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. You have until 10 PM to grab a scoop, which is the current closing time for our local Culver's.
